caveats: Flight carbon dioxide is estimated from RP-1 the simulation burned times a combustion factor. It is not a measured plume.
Liquid oxygen is not counted as fuel. Building the rocket is excluded. This is direct carbon dioxide, not CO2e or soot warming.
A replay model is separate from a flown simulation. Missing burn details stay unknown instead of using a sample timeline.
Rocket carbon dioxide is a tiny global share. No numerical fraction is calculated here.

co2PerMerlinSecondKg.unit: kg CO2 per engine per second
co2PerMerlinSecondKg.note: 277 is rounded from assumed 295 kg/s propellant / (1 + 2.356 oxidizer:fuel) x assumed 3.15 kg CO2/kg fuel. 290 is an illustrative upper model input, not a verified FAA emission rate. The flight counter does not use this per-second rate.

co2PerMvacSecondKg.unit: kg CO2 per engine per second
co2PerMvacSecondKg.source: Demo assumption for vacuum-engine CO2 rate; FAA background
co2PerMvacSecondKg.note: 219 kg CO2 per engine-second is a demo model input; it is not a verified FAA value. The flight counter does not use this per-second rate.

entryBurnEngines.source: Demo burn-profile assumption; vehicle background from SpaceX
entryBurnEngines.note: Assumed engine count for a retired timeline sketch. It is not a measured event and the flight counter does not use it.

entryBurnSeconds.source: Demo burn-profile assumption; vehicle background from SpaceX
entryBurnSeconds.note: Assumed duration for a retired timeline sketch. Missing historical burns stay unknown. The flight counter does not use it.

landingBurnEngines.source: Demo burn-profile assumption; vehicle background from SpaceX
landingBurnEngines.note: Assumed engine count for a retired timeline sketch. The flight counter does not use it.

landingBurnSeconds.source: Demo burn-profile assumption; vehicle background from SpaceX
landingBurnSeconds.note: Assumed duration for a retired timeline sketch. The flight counter does not use it.

blackCarbonT.source: Demo assumption; background: Barker, Marais & McDowell 2024, Scientific Data; also Ryan 2022, Maloney 2022
blackCarbonT.note: 3 t with illustrative 0.4–17 t sensitivity bounds is a demo assumption informed by launch-emissions literature; these exact values have not been verified from this paper. Soot is not added to the carbon-dioxide counter.

waterVaporT.source: Demo assumption; background: Derived from Barker, Marais & McDowell 2024, Scientific Data and Ryan et al. 2022, Earth's Future
waterVaporT.note: 180 t with illustrative 150–210 t sensitivity bounds is a demo assumption; these exact values have not been verified from the linked paper. Water is not added to the carbon-dioxide counter.

sootWarmingFactor.note: Ryan et al. abstract reports rocket black-carbon warming per emitted mass about 500 times that of surface and aviation sources. This is not a CO2e conversion factor or a whole-launch multiplier.

upperAtmosphereYears.source: Demo assumption; background: NASA Technical Memorandum NASA/TM-20240013276
upperAtmosphereYears.note: Four years is a demo residence-time assumption; the exact figure has not been verified in the linked NASA memorandum and must not be attributed as a NASA measurement.

newBoosterCo2T.source: Unverified demo manufacturing assumption; vehicle background only
newBoosterCo2T.note: 420 tonnes CO2e is an unverified, low-confidence demo manufacturing assumption. It is not direct CO2 and is excluded from every flight counter and car comparison.

carCo2PerYearT.unit: tonnes CO2 per car per year
carCo2PerYearT.source: US EPA, Greenhouse Gas Emissions from a Typical Passenger Vehicle

flightCo2PerPassengerKm.source: Demo assumption; background: UK DESNZ conversion factors via Our World in Data
flightCo2PerPassengerKm.note: Assumed direct-CO2 comparison rate, not a verified OWID or UK conversion factor. It is not used in the flight counter.

rocketShareOfHumanCo2.source: Qualitative context; no numerical global-share estimate
rocketShareOfHumanCo2.note: No numerical fraction is supported here. Do not compare propellant tonnes with global CO2 tonnes or infer a global share from this demo flight model.

faaCo2Below100kFtT.source: Unverified legacy demo input; FAA background document
faaCo2Below100kFtT.note: 274 t is retained only as an unverified demo assumption; no exact FAA table or conversion has been verified. It is not used in the flight counter.

faaLandingCo2T.source: Unverified legacy demo input; FAA background document
faaLandingCo2T.note: 90.4 t is retained only as an unverified demo assumption; no exact FAA table or conversion has been verified. It is not a measured upper bound and is not used in the flight counter.

stage2BurnSeconds.source: Demo assumption; background: SpaceX Falcon 9 vehicle page, second stage burn time
stage2BurnSeconds.note: 397 s is an unverified published-burn background figure. Player emissions do not use a fixed burn length.

flightRouteKm.source: Demo assumption; background: Rounded great-circle distance, New York to London
flightRouteKm.note: Background distance only. It is not used in the flight counter.

merlinPropellantKgPerS.source: Demo assumption; background: Derived from FAA SLC-40 Environmental Assessment, App. A (Sierra Engineering plume model, 2019)
merlinPropellantKgPerS.note: 295 kg/s is an unverified flow assumption; the linked FAA document is background, not evidence for this exact value. The flight counter uses consumed RP-1 mass, not this rate.

merlinMixtureRatio.source: FAA SLC-40 Environmental Assessment, App. A (Sierra Engineering plume model, 2019)
merlinMixtureRatio.note: Oxidizer:fuel ratio 2.356 appears at PDF page 77 (zero-based index 76) of the FAA SLC-40 EA. It is a model parameter, not a measured in-flight rate. It is used only to turn mixed LOX+RP-1 mass into RP-1 mass.

co2PerKgKeroseneKg.source: Demo kerosene combustion-factor assumption; ICAO background
co2PerKgKeroseneKg.note: 3.15 is an assumed model factor, not presented as an official or verified ICAO value. The flight counter multiplies consumed RP-1 kilograms by this factor.

co2PerMerlinSecondFaaKg.unit: kg CO2 per engine per second
co2PerMerlinSecondFaaKg.source: Unverified legacy demo input; FAA background document
co2PerMerlinSecondFaaKg.note: 290 kg/s is an illustrative sensitivity input, not a verified FAA plume-model result. The flight counter does not use it.
